name: wrenote-desktop
description: Electron shell for Wrenote — hosts the Python server as a loopback sidecar (P0 migration off pywebview).

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wrenote transcribes speech from your microphone, locally on your device.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wrenote records a chosen window or screen alongside your audio when you enable screen capture.
